verdict.rationale: EBANX documents signed HTTP POST status notifications to a configured Notification URL, with redelivery on failure (ebanx-docs-21, ebanx-docs-22). It also offers a unified payments API with structured error responses (ebanx-docs-18, ebanx-docs-26), so an agent could detect failed payments. Its Recurring Payments marketing claims 'smart retry logic', but this is not documented as an API an agent can drive (ebanx-docs-34). Missing for 10: documented failed-payment or decline-specific webhook events, an API to trigger or configure payment retries, any dunning or customer outreach capability, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
